label: Every first mover moved by none is first in being, from the quarta via with PRIOR_4 (inference)
rule: Apply the existing first-mover-is-first-being theorem at the PRIOR_4 relation
meaning: PRIOR_4 sibling of argument f8992ef7, by its existing theorem firstMoverIsFirstBeing instantiated with PriorInBeing CanBeWithout for its priority parameter. Something m is maximal in being (quarta via); whatever else is PRIOR_4 to m causes its being (the PRIOR_4 sibling of 70e98bb5), so it is more a being than m, which nothing is; every first mover moved by none is m. The premises are those of f8992ef7 with the PRIOR_4 sibling in place of 70e98bb5; all remain open. The CAUSE_1/CAUSE_2 and MAXIMAL_6/MAXIMAL_1 mixings are inherited from f8992ef7, where they are allowlisted legacy; here the premises that relate those senses are listed as bridges: 777646a5 (an agent whose being God causes is moved when it moves, relating causing being and moving) and 101bdd62 (maximally true is maximally a being, which links both maximality senses).
